description: Source code for the search layer of the Mattermost server, specifically handling post indexing, deletion, and search functionalities within channels and user contexts.

classes.name: SearchPostStore
classes.description: Struct managing post search indexing, deletion, and retrieval, integrating with search engines and the post store.

methods.name: indexPost
methods.description: Indexes a post across active search engines if indexing is enabled.

methods.name: deletePostIndex
methods.description: Deletes a specific post from all active search engine indexes.

methods.name: deleteChannelPostsIndex
methods.description: Removes all posts of a channel from search engine indexes.

methods.name: deleteUserPostsIndex
methods.description: Removes all posts of a user from search engine indexes.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a post in the store and reindexes it.

methods.name: Overwrite
methods.description: Overwrites a post in the store and reindexes it.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new post in the store and indexes it.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a post from the store and removes it from the index.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Permanently deletes a post and removes it from the index.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes all posts by a user and updates the index.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes all posts in a channel and updates the index.

methods.name: searchPostsForUserByEngine
methods.description: Performs a search for posts for a user using a specific search engine.

methods.name: SearchPostsForUser
methods.description: Performs a user-specific post search across available search engines or falls back to database search.
